scripts.dev: bash -c 'unset npm_config_prefix && source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && vite build --watch'
scripts.build: bash -c 'unset npm_config_prefix && source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && tsc && vite build'
scripts.lint: bash -c 'unset npm_config_prefix && source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && eslint .'
scripts.lint:fix: bash -c 'unset npm_config_prefix && source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && eslint . --fix'
scripts.test: bash -c 'unset npm_config_prefix && source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && jest'
scripts.test:watch: bash -c 'unset npm_config_prefix && source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && jest --watch'
scripts.test:coverage: bash -c 'unset npm_config_prefix && source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && jest --coverage'
